title: Transmission system voltage low
plainEnglishMeaning: The voltage available to the transmission control system was too low for dependable operation.
failureCriteria: The reproduced diagnostic chart treats less than 9 volts as a low-voltage supply condition; the exact code-setting duration is not yet verified.

likelyCauses.cause: Poor connection at the starter-solenoid feed or fusible link
PCM fault only if the measured supply remains normal

falsePositiveConditions: A voltage drop caused by another electrical load can set this code without a transmission component failure.
confirmatoryTests: Measure battery and charging voltage while the fault is present.
Perform voltage-drop tests across the transmission and PCM power feeds.
Check whether operating a specific accessory causes the voltage drop.
